data.body: Final disposition after reassessment against current origin/main: the reported 401 behavior was caused by ambient-root model-class discovery, not by an attempted fallback. That defect was fixed and merged as c390cef54a (Gerrit 1494), with the original reproduction now resolving to the configured Bedrock class. The separately approved work to enable direct Anthropic as a class-level fallback remains open on esthetical-earthborn-vervet; closing this original misrouting bug does not close or defer that follow-up.
